name: An unannotated method has the Dynamic<Object> return contract

input.fixture_ref: Inspect the runtime Method signature for a named method that omits -> ReturnType.

applicability.reason: Requires Method signature reflection. The C118 inventory is complete and `Reflection::Class.method` returns an unbound Method, but no operation reports that Method's declared return contract, so an unannotated method cannot be distinguished from an annotated one.

expect.status: The published return contract is Dynamic<Object>, not the inferred body result.
